notFound.emptyDescription: Check the link, or start again from the dashboard. Nothing was lost — the address simply does not match a page.
notFound.title: Not found
notFound.subtitle: That page does not exist.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitleLong: What the scout and assistant use to match and draft. None of it leaves your device.
profile.explainHint: The longer subtitle about scoring and privacy

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Connections, sync and your data
settings.storageBlocked: This browser is blocking site storage, so your theme and sound preferences are not remembered between visits. Private windows and some managed browsers do this. Whether your records are being saved is a separate question — Diagnostics below answers it.

jobScout.title: Job scout
jobScout.snapshotDescription: The page kept for this posting, {{name}}. Press Escape to go back to Job scout.

vault.title: Vault
vault.subtitle: Everything you set aside to come back to
vault.showCountsHint: Item totals in the page subtitle

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.subtitleEmpty: {{date}} · nothing tracked yet — everything you add stays on this machine.

organisation.missingSubtitle: Nothing here answers to that address
organisation.missingDescription: An employer page exists for as long as an application names it. If every application to this one was deleted, so was this.
organisation.datesEmptyDescription: Deadlines, interviews and reminders about any of these jobs collect on this page.
organisation.peopleEmptyDescription: Referees, search chairs and recruiters named on any of these jobs show up here.

graph.title: Graph
graph.emptySubtitle: Nothing to draw yet — the graph is built from the records in your store.
graph.emptyDescription: Applications, reminders, files and keywords become nodes here, and the pointers between them become edges. Add the first application and the graph starts drawing itself.
graph.subtitle: The knowledge graph your records are stored in, drawn. Every node is a record in this browser and every edge is a pointer between two of them.
graph.labelEveryHint: Off, hubs and whatever you are pointing at are named, and anything that would overlap is dropped
graph.hideLonersHint: Drops anything with no edges — usually a file or link filed under nothing
graph.reorganizeHint: Arrange the same records a different way
graph.resetHint: Put the records back in their usual arrangement
graph.help: Hover or tab to a node to trace its neighbourhood, press to select it, drag to move it. Node colour is its kind, size is how much points at it.

applications.title: Applications
applications.showNotesHint: The second line under each position in the table
applications.compactHint: Tighter row height in the table
applications.subtitleEmpty: Nothing tracked yet — everything you add stays on this machine.
applications.subtitle: {{shown}} shown · {{total}} total
applications.emptyDescription: Track a job you are applying for and it shows up here, on the calendar and in the week ahead.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Deadlines, interviews and prep in one view
calendar.exportFailedTitle: The calendar file could not be written
calendar.exportFailedDescription: The browser refused the download. Nothing has changed here.
calendar.exportedDescription: {{file}} is in your downloads. Open it and your calendar will offer to import them, with a reminder on each.
calendar.dotsOnlyHint: Denser month grid — detail and dragging move to the day you select
calendar.tallCellsHint: More room per day in the grid

applicationDetail.missingDescription: It was deleted, or the link points at a record that never existed. Nothing else was removed with it.
applicationDetail.closedAccepted: Recorded as accepted. The offer details and its reminders were kept.
applicationDetail.closedDeclined: Recorded as declined. The offer details and its reminders were kept.
applicationDetail.duplicatedDescription: The copy starts at Draft, with the note and details carried over.
applicationDetail.confirmKept: The application and its note go. {{kept}} will be kept but unlinked — nothing you filed under it is deleted.
applicationDetail.confirmAlone: The application and its note go. Nothing else points at it.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.scopedEmptySubtitle: The role filter in the top bar leaves nothing to measure.
statistics.emptySubtitle: Nothing to measure yet — this page fills in as you add applications.
statistics.emptyDescription: Response rates, a funnel and a week-by-week chart all need records to count. Add the first one and this page starts filling in.
statistics.countedScoped_one: Counted from the {{shown}} of your {{count}} application under the roles picked in the top bar.
statistics.countedScoped_other: Counted from the {{shown}} of your {{count}} applications under the roles picked in the top bar.
statistics.typicalNote: Figures labelled typical are a sample search, there to compare against.
statistics.fillsIn: It fills in as applications go out.
statistics.compareTypicalHint: A sample figure beside each headline number
statistics.asFarAsShown: as far as each record shows
statistics.nothingSentDescription: Reply, interview and offer rates all count applications that have actually gone out. Move one out of Draft and this fills in.
statistics.noOutcomeDescription: An outcome is what came back, so only applications that have gone out can have one. Every record here is still a draft.
statistics.rolesTitle: How each kind of role is going
statistics.rolesCaption: Applications, replies, interviews and offers by kind of role
